description: Lambda function implementations: Polly worker (audio + speech marks), Marp render handler (PDF/PPTX/PNG generation logic), and Composition builder (Hyperframes index.html generation)
steps: In lambdas/polly-worker/src/index.ts, implement Lambda handler that: receives event with {projectId, userId, version, slideNumber, presenterNote, voiceId, engine, sampleRate, s3Bucket, s3Prefix}. Makes two Polly SynthesizeSpeech calls via AWS SDK v3 @aws-sdk/client-polly: (1) OutputFormat pcm with the text, (2) OutputFormat json with SpeechMarkTypes [word, sentence]. Validates text length <= 3000 billable chars. Uploads PCM to audio/slide-{NNN}.pcm and marks to audio/slide-{NNN}-marks.json in S3. Calculates measuredAudioMs from PCM file size. Returns {slideNumber, voiceKey, speechMarksKey, measuredAudioMs}.

In lambdas/polly-worker/src/ssml.ts, implement SSML builder: wraps presenter note text in <speak> tags, adds prosody rate if specified, handles Japanese phoneme corrections for AWS service names via lexicon references

In lambdas/marp-render/src/index.ts, implement Lambda handler that: receives event with {projectId, userId, version, deckMarkdown, s3Bucket, s3Prefix, outputs: ['pdf', 'pptx', 'png']}. Note: this Lambda will run as container image with Marp CLI + Chromium. Handler writes deck.md to /tmp, executes marp CLI commands via child_process for each output format. Uploads results to S3 following the key structure: versions/v{NNNN}/deck.pdf, deck.pptx, slides/deck.{NNN}.png. Returns {pdfKey, pptxKey, slideImageKeys: string[]}.
In lambdas/marp-render/src/marp-commands.ts, implement command builders: marp --pdf deck.md, marp --pptx deck.md, marp --images png --image-scale 2 deck.md. Handle stdout/stderr for error detection.
In lambdas/marp-render/Dockerfile, create container image definition: FROM public.ecr.aws/lambda/nodejs:22, install chromium, marp-cli, noto-sans-cjk fonts. Set Lambda handler entry point.

In lambdas/composition-builder/src/index.ts, implement Lambda handler that: receives event with {manifest: VideoManifest, s3Bucket, s3Prefix, assetsPrefix}. Generates Hyperframes-compatible index.html with:
stage element with data-composition-id, data-width, data-height, data-fps. For each slide: with data-start (seconds), data-duration (seconds), src pointing to PNG.

In lambdas/composition-builder/src/html-builder.ts, implement the HTML composition template generation following design section 11.1: stage div with composition metadata attributes, slide images as clips with timing, audio elements with timing, caption overlay with synchronized text

Write unit tests for each Lambda: test Polly worker with mocked @aws-sdk/client-polly (verify correct API params, PCM size calculation), test Marp render with mocked child_process (verify command construction), test composition builder with sample manifest (verify HTML structure and timing calculations)
acceptance_criteria: Polly worker handler validates 3000 char limit and returns error for oversized text
Polly worker makes two separate SynthesizeSpeech calls (pcm + json speech marks)
Polly worker calculates measuredAudioMs from PCM byte count (bytes / 2 / 24000 * 1000)
Marp render handler constructs correct marp CLI commands for pdf, pptx, and png outputs
Marp render Dockerfile installs chromium, marp-cli, and Noto Sans CJK fonts
Composition builder generates valid HTML with correct timing attributes from manifest
All Lambda unit tests pass with pnpm test
pnpm build compiles all lambda packages
verification: Run pnpm test to confirm all Lambda unit tests pass
Run pnpm build to confirm TypeScript compilation succeeds
